items.title: Special right to terminate electricity contract due to price increase
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit der Anpassung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie Ihren Liefervertrag fristlos auf den Tag kündigen, an dem die neuen Preise gelten (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG).
items.computation: The letter grants a statutory special termination right (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG) allowing termination without notice, effective on the day the new prices take effect, i.e. 01.08.2025. The letter does not state an explicit deadline by which the termination notice must reach the provider. To avoid the new price applying at all, the cancellation would need to reach the provider before the new prices take effect, i.e. by the last day of the old term, 31.07.2025. No weekend/holiday adjustment applies because this is a private notice-of-termination date, not a statutory period ending, and 31.07.2025 is a Thursday in any case. This date is an inferred earliest plausible deadline, not one printed in the letter.
